note: Each case is a claim the contract makes about evidence. tests/run-conformance.sh fails unless every planned case ran and matched. `proves` names the sentence in EVIDENCE-CONTRACT.adoc the case keeps honest.

verify.name: three executed example tests, unproven and provisionally-proven
verify.proves: The positive control: real executed evidence is admitted and covers the two distinct coordinates it names.

verify.name: the same submission under --require-green
verify.proves: A green claim is available — and only with the caller's own commit and repo pinned.

verify.name: property sampling and a checked proof, told apart
verify.proves: A property (256 cases, shrinker, no failures) is provisionally-proven; a proof with a checker that ran and one witnessed rung is actually-proven. Neither is allowed to borrow the other's tier.

verify.name: a debt-marked test covers nothing
verify.proves: TEST-DOCTRINE B.4: a FixtureDebt record is admissible but is excluded from coverage and from the test count. Two executed passes cover one cell.

verify.name: a pass with no execution record
verify.proves: A `passed` record is not a run. Without execution.ran=true it is inadmissible and covers nothing.

verify.name: a pass whose process exited non-zero
verify.proves: exit_code is the process's own word; a pass at exit 1 is refused.

verify.name: a pass with no captured output
verify.proves: An executed test leaves a log; without a digest of it, the claim cannot be audited.

verify.name: a pass whose timestamps run backwards
verify.proves: finished_at before started_at is a fabricated execution window.

verify.name: a pass produced by a no-op command
verify.proves: `true` cannot produce a passing test; the command is part of the evidence.

verify.name: a skipped test claimed as provisionally-proven and counted
verify.proves: A skip is not a pass and establishes no warrant, and a coverage claim that counts it is refused against the derivation.

verify.name: a skip with no reason
verify.proves: An unlabelled skip reads as a pass to everyone downstream, so it is refused here.

verify.name: a property that ran zero cases
verify.proves: Zero cases is a runner fault, not sampling evidence.

verify.name: a property with no shrinker
verify.proves: A property whose failing case could not have been minimised is a weaker object than the taxonomy's property category.

verify.name: a proof naming no witnessed rungs
verify.proves: Actually-Proven requires a non-empty ladder (List1 Witnessed); an empty ladder is a label without a term.

verify.name: a proof whose checker did not run
verify.proves: A citation that was not re-checked in this run evidences nothing about this tree.

verify.name: an example claiming to be actually-proven
verify.proves: Tiers cannot be borrowed: actually_proven needs kind=proof with a checker, not an example with a certificate bolted on.

verify.name: a coverage claim larger than the derivation
verify.proves: Coverage is derived from executed passes; a claim of 7 covered cells over 2 tests is refused, and the derivation still reports the true 1.

verify.name: evidence for an older commit, with the commit pinned
verify.proves: Evidence from another commit is replayable garbage; with --expect-commit the replay fails.

verify.name: the same stale evidence with nothing pinned
verify.proves: The honest limitation: binding is the caller's job. Without --expect-commit the validator cannot know which commit was intended. This case exists so nobody reads R6 as automatic.

verify.name: a contract major this revision cannot read
verify.proves: A newer evidence format is refused, not reinterpreted in the old vocabulary.

verify.name: the same test id twice
verify.proves: Two records for one id make every count ambiguous.

verify.name: counts that do not reconcile
verify.proves: A summary claiming 41 tests over one record is refused: the submitter's own arithmetic is checked.

verify.name: a test that states no fixture position
verify.proves: TEST-DOCTRINE §2: there is no silent default. A test without a fixture pair, a cannot-fail-by-design reason or a debt reference is inadmissible — and it covers nothing.

verify.name: a coordinate this taxonomy does not have
verify.proves: "Unit" is a display name, not a taxonomy category; an unknown coordinate covers nothing.

verify.name: a failing test in an otherwise green-looking submission
verify.proves: Failure evidence is honest and admissible — and it can never be green. The two questions are separate.

verify.name: a run whose exit code disagrees with its records
verify.proves: run.exit_code 1 with no failing record means the harness failed outside the tests; the aggregate and the per-test records must agree (R11).

collect.name: a clean cargo test run
collect.proves: The reference producer reads three ok lines and three coordinates into an admissible, green submission.

collect.name: a run with one #[ignore]d test
collect.proves: An ignored test is recorded as skipped with its reason, covers nothing, and stops a green claim. It is not quietly dropped.

collect.name: a run with a genuine failure
collect.proves: A failure is recorded as a failure with its detail, is admissible, and is never green.

collect.name: a run that executed nothing
collect.proves: Zero tests is not evidence. The collector refuses rather than emitting an empty submission that would read as green-adjacent.

collect.name: a log whose summary disagrees with its test lines
collect.proves: A log claiming 3 passed while naming 1 is tampered or truncated; the collector refuses.

collect.name: an executed test with no coordinate
collect.proves: The collector will not invent a coordinate. An unmapped test is refused by name, so coverage cannot be padded.

collect.name: an exit code that disagrees with the log
collect.proves: A non-zero exit with no failing test means the harness failed outside the tests; that run evidences nothing about the suite.
